<h1>Dental Implants vs Laser Hair Removal: Which is Better? (2026)</h1></p>
<h2>Quick Comparison</h2>
<p>| Factor | Dental Implants | Laser Hair Removal |
|--------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Cost | $4000-5000 | $300-600 |
| Duration | 1-2 hours | 15-60 minutes |
| Results | Lifetime with proper care | Permanent reduction |
| Recovery | 3-6 months | 24 hours |</p>
<h2>Dental Implants Overview</h2>
<p>Titanium posts surgically placed in jawbone to replace missing tooth roots.</p>
<p><strong>Best for</strong>: [Target patient profile]</p>
<h2>Laser Hair Removal Overview</h2>
<p>Concentrated light beams to remove unwanted hair by destroying hair follicles.</p>
<p><strong>Best for</strong>: [Target patient profile]</p>
<h2>Which Should You Choose?</h2>
<p>Consider your goals, budget, and lifestyle when making this decision. Schedule consultations with experienced providers in Los Angeles to discuss your specific needs.</p>
